parameters.memo_body:
Hi Cynthia, after carefully reviewing all the candidates, I conclude that Casey is the successful candidate for the firefighter position. Casey presents a best-fit combination of experience and fitness score, compared to the others. Below is a summary of the analysis of the candidates considered:
- Michael: Fitness Score of 85 (with 5 years of experience)
- Christopher: Fitness Score of 90 (with 7 years of experience)
- David: Fitness Score of 80 (with 10 years of experience)
- Thomas: Fitness Score of 88 (with 4 years of experience)
- Casey: Fitness Score of 92 (with 12 years of experience)
